correctness.rationale: Scaling v=3y/2 gives G=(au+v,ru(1−u)) with r=3b/2, and at a=0,r=4 its square is (L,L). The logistic sine-square identity gives each full lap and derivative at an inverse target s in J′ of magnitude at least 2^m·2√(s(1−s))≥2^m√15/8. The retained product inverse sheets Q send J′² strictly inside separate laps of J². To check global persistence for each sheet without relying on chart patching, set Ξ=G_{a,r}^{2m}∘Q on J′²; Ξ tends to the identity in C¹ there. For any z∈J², y↦z−(Ξ(y)−y) is a contraction of J′² into its interior for all sufficiently close parameters (use the coordinate margin 1/16). This gives a unique fixed point, smoothly in z on a neighborhood of J², and the continued inverse sheet Q∘Ξ⁻¹ there. A single small radius for the finitely many sheets preserves their separation and inverse differential norms <1/2. The original-coordinate inverse differential norm is <3/4 by the condition number of the scaling. The nested disjoint contracting images give a homeomorphism with the one-sided shift, and the forward iterates staying in the union of q_i(int J²) give exactly the repeller by repeated inverse contraction. Its compact orbit union under the original map is invariant; iteration divides the entropy log(k_m²) by 2m for the stated bound. Writing N=2^m, α=(2/π)arcsin(1/√8), strict endpoints give integers floor(Nα)+1 through ceil(N(1−α))−2. Thus k_m=N−2 floor(Nα)−2. At m=3, x_{3,1}=sin²(π/16)<1/8 and x_{3,2}=(2−√2)/4>1/8; by symmetry precisely j=2,3,4,5 qualify. Subsequent dyadic refinements keep subdividing these laps. The exact count yields the stated asymptotic. At the anchor only, compact orbits must belong to [0,1]² because an exterior logistic coordinate escapes; the two tent factors give entropy 2log 2 for the second iterate on the square, so the reference value is log 2. The bundled script was read and not executed, and its finite checks are not evidence for a uniform parameter radius or the all-m claim.
residual_risks: The proof is existential in an m-dependent radius. It does not establish log 2 at a fixed positive coupling, a common radius, a physical attractor, or an ambient noncompact entropy bound.
